plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: The process layer: 4 agents (plan/developer/verify/review) plus shared skills for evidence discipline, output contracts, arbitration, vendoring provenance, secret scanning, walkthroughs, world-class UI/UX design and audit for both web and mobile, and doc-coherence -- the traceability registry and propagation contract that stops a PRD, a schema design, an API reference and a Postman collection from drifting apart.

plugins.name: react-sdlc
plugins.description: Scaffold, vertical-slice, gate, and release skills for React + Vite + TypeScript. Generalized greenfield and adopt-in-place version-selection profiles, feature-based architecture with enforced import boundaries, and best-in-market state and routing patterns.

plugins.name: flutter-sdlc
plugins.description: Scaffold, vertical-slice, gate, and release skills for Flutter. flutter_bloc with Cubit as the settled state-management choice, Service/Repository/Cubit/Screen layering with sealed Result and state types, and a strict-analysis gate.

plugins.name: schema-architect
plugins.description: Model, document, emit, audit, and promote skills for Oracle schema design. Parameterized naming, audit-column, soft-delete, and migration-versioning conventions grounded in current industry practice rather than any single project's choices -- plus the twelve-section design document a team reviews before DDL ships, where every foreign key carries an ON DELETE behaviour and a written rationale.

plugins.name: api-architect
plugins.description: Contract, collection, emit-handler, audit, and publish skills for REST APIs. Stack-neutral rules (real HTTP status codes, RFC 9457 problem+json, resource-oriented verbs, cursor pagination, bearer auth, idempotency, optimistic concurrency) with Oracle ORDS as the worked implementation -- and a Postman collection plus API reference generated from one manifest, so the two cannot disagree.

plugins.name: docs-architect
plugins.description: PRD, context, onboarding, reference, and guide skills spanning a project's whole documentation lifecycle. Writes the MD.050 page-level design a business reviewer signs before any code exists, maintains the 3-tier agent context (code-review-graph, graphify, llmwiki), writes a cross-stack onboarding trace instead of four drifting per-stack docs, derives API and schema reference from the live dictionary, and produces user guides with a regenerable screenshot manifest.

plugins.name: agent-sdlc
plugins.description: Scaffold, vertical-slice, gate, and release skills for AI Agents (LangGraph, CrewAI, StateGraph). Strongly-typed State, deterministic tool schemas, SQLite/PostgreSQL checkpointing persistence, human-in-the-loop review interrupts, and context-firewalled subagents.
